"""python-pptx 绘图原语:文本 / 盒 / 芯片标签 / 连线箭头 / 表格 / 图片卡。

所有坐标一律用英寸浮点;颜色一律用 theme 的 RRGGBB 字符串。
每页 content 模块只 import 本模块与 theme,不直接碰 python-pptx。
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os

from PIL import Image
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_CONNECTOR, MSO_SHAPE
from pptx.enum.text import MSO_ANCHOR, PP_ALIGN
from pptx.oxml.ns import qn
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt

from . import theme as T

_ALIGN = {'l': PP_ALIGN.LEFT, 'c': PP_ALIGN.CENTER, 'r': PP_ALIGN.RIGHT}
_ANCHOR = {'t': MSO_ANCHOR.TOP, 'm': MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE, 'b': MSO_ANCHOR.BOTTOM}

ASSETS = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))), 'assets')
_CROP_CACHE = os.path.join(ASSETS, '.cache')


def rgb(c: str) -> RGBColor:
    return RGBColor.from_string(c)


def est_w(text: str, size_pt: float) -> float:
    """估算单行文本宽度(英寸):CJK 全角 1.0 em、其余 0.55 em。用于 chip 自动宽。"""
    units = sum(1.0 if ord(ch) > 0x2E80 else 0.55 for ch in text)
    return units * size_pt / 72.0


def _style_run(run, size, color, bold, mono, italic=False):
    f = run.font
    f.size = Pt(size)
    f.bold = bold
    f.italic = italic
    f.color.rgb = rgb(color)
    f.name = T.FONT_MONO if mono else T.FONT_LAT
    # 东亚字体要单独写 a:ea(font.name 只落 a:latin)
    rPr = run._r.get_or_add_rPr()
    ea = rPr.find(qn('a:ea'))
    if ea is None:
        ea = rPr.makeelement(qn('a:ea'), {})
        rPr.append(ea)
    ea.set('typeface', T.FONT_MONO if mono else T.FONT_EA)


def _fill_paragraph(p, para, size, color, bold, mono, align, leading, space_after):
    """para: str 或 [(text, style_dict), ...];style_dict 可覆盖 size/color/bold/mono/italic。"""
    p.alignment = _ALIGN[align]
    if leading:
        p.line_spacing = leading
    if space_after is not None:
        p.space_after = Pt(space_after)
    runs = [(para, {})] if isinstance(para, str) else para
    for txt, st in runs:
        r = p.add_run()
        r.text = txt
        _style_run(r, st.get('size', size), st.get('color', color),
                   st.get('bold', bold), st.get('mono', mono), st.get('italic', False))


def text(slide, x, y, w, h, content, size=T.F_BODY, color=T.FG, bold=False,
         mono=False, align='l', anchor='t', leading=1.06, space_after=2, wrap=True):
    """文本框。content: str(按 \\n 分段) / list[段],段=str 或 [(txt, style), ...]。"""
    tb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(x), Inches(y), Inches(w), Inches(h))
    tf = tb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = wrap
    tf.vertical_anchor = _ANCHOR[anchor]
    for m in ('margin_left', 'margin_right', 'margin_top', 'margin_bottom'):
        setattr(tf, m, 0)
    paras = content.split('\n') if isinstance(content, str) else content
    for i, para in enumerate(paras):
        p = tf.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()
        _fill_paragraph(p, para, size, color, bold, mono, align, leading, space_after)
    return tb


def box(slide, x, y, w, h, fill=T.WHITE, line=T.LINE, line_w=0.75, radius=0.08,
        content=None, size=T.F_BODY, color=T.FG, bold=False, align='c', anchor='m',
        dash=None, shape=MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE):
    """圆角矩形(radius=0 用直角)。content 直接写进形状文本框。"""
    if radius == 0:
        shape = MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE
    sp = slide.shapes.add_shape(shape, Inches(x), Inches(y), Inches(w), Inches(h))
    sp.shadow.inherit = False
    if shape == MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE:
        sp.adjustments[0] = radius
    if fill is None:
        sp.fill.background()
    else:
        sp.fill.solid()
        sp.fill.fore_color.rgb = rgb(fill)
    if line is None:
        sp.line.fill.background()
    else:
        sp.line.color.rgb = rgb(line)
        sp.line.width = Pt(line_w)
        if dash:
            _set_dash(sp.line, dash)
    if content is not None:
        tf = sp.text_frame
        tf.word_wrap = True
        tf.vertical_anchor = _ANCHOR[anchor]
        tf.margin_left = tf.margin_right = Inches(0.06)
        tf.margin_top = tf.margin_bottom = Inches(0.03)
        paras = content.split('\n') if isinstance(content, str) else content
        for i, para in enumerate(paras):
            p = tf.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()
            _fill_paragraph(p, para, size, color, bold, False, align, 1.02, 0)
    return sp


def _set_dash(line_format, dash):
    ln = line_format._get_or_add_ln()
    pd = ln.find(qn('a:prstDash'))
    if pd is None:
        pd = ln.makeelement(qn('a:prstDash'), {})
        ln.append(pd)
    pd.set('val', dash)  # 'dash' | 'sysDot' | ...


def chip(slide, x, y, label, color=T.ACCENT, size=T.F_CHIP, h=0.22, filled=False, w=None):
    """小圆角标签。filled=True 实底白字,否则浅底深字。返回 (shape, 实际宽)。"""
    cw = w if w is not None else est_w(label, size) + 0.18
    sp = box(slide, x, y, cw, h,
             fill=color if filled else T.tint(color, 0.88),
             line=None if filled else T.mix(color, 'FFFFFF', 0.55),
             radius=0.5, content=[[(label, {})]],
             size=size, color=T.WHITE if filled else T.mix(color, '000000', 0.15),
             bold=True)
    return sp, cw


def line(slide, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=T.LINE, width=1.0, dash=None):
    conn = slide.shapes.add_connector(MSO_CONNECTOR.STRAIGHT,
                                      Inches(x1), Inches(y1), Inches(x2), Inches(y2))
    conn.shadow.inherit = False
    conn.line.color.rgb = rgb(color)
    conn.line.width = Pt(width)
    if dash:
        _set_dash(conn.line, dash)
    return conn


def arrow(slide, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=T.DIM, width=1.5, dash=None, both=False):
    conn = line(slide, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=color, width=width, dash=dash)
    ln = conn.line._get_or_add_ln()
    ends = ['tailEnd'] + (['headEnd'] if both else [])
    for end in ends:
        el = ln.find(qn(f'a:{end}'))
        if el is None:
            el = ln.makeelement(qn(f'a:{end}'), {})
            ln.append(el)
        el.set('type', 'triangle')
        el.set('w', 'med')
        el.set('len', 'med')
    return conn


def table(slide, x, y, w, rows, col_w=None, row_h=0.30, header=True,
          size=T.F_TABLE, header_fill=T.ACCENT, zebra=True, align=None, first_col_bold=False):
    """商务风表格:表头实底白字,正文斑马纹,无竖线。
    rows: list[list[cell]],cell = str 或 (str, style_dict)。
    col_w: 列宽权重(自动归一到 w);align: 每列 'l'/'c'/'r' 列表。
    """
    n_r, n_c = len(rows), len(rows[0])
    gf = slide.shapes.add_table(n_r, n_c, Inches(x), Inches(y), Inches(w), Inches(row_h * n_r))
    tbl = gf.table
    tbl.first_row = False
    tbl.horz_banding = False
    weights = col_w or [1] * n_c
    total = sum(weights)
    for ci, wt in enumerate(weights):
        tbl.columns[ci].width = Inches(w * wt / total)
    for ri in range(n_r):
        tbl.rows[ri].height = Inches(row_h)
    for ri, row in enumerate(rows):
        is_head = header and ri == 0
        for ci, cell_val in enumerate(row):
            cell = tbl.cell(ri, ci)
            cell.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE
            cell.margin_left = cell.margin_right = Inches(0.07)
            cell.margin_top = cell.margin_bottom = Inches(0.02)
            cell.fill.solid()
            if is_head:
                cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = rgb(header_fill)
            else:
                body_i = ri - (1 if header else 0)
                cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = rgb(T.PANEL if (zebra and body_i % 2) else T.WHITE)
            txt, st = cell_val if isinstance(cell_val, tuple) else (cell_val, {})
            tf = cell.text_frame
            tf.word_wrap = True
            for pi, para in enumerate(str(txt).split('\n')):
                p = tf.paragraphs[0] if pi == 0 else tf.add_paragraph()
                p.alignment = _ALIGN[(align[ci] if align else 'l')]
                r = p.add_run()
                r.text = para
                _style_run(r,
                           st.get('size', size),
                           st.get('color', T.WHITE if is_head else (T.FG if not st else st.get('color', T.FG))),
                           st.get('bold', is_head or (first_col_bold and ci == 0)),
                           st.get('mono', False))
    return gf


def crop_image(src, crop_px, tag):
    """裁切并缓存(crop_px = (left, top, right, bottom) 像素)。返回缓存文件路径。"""
    os.makedirs(_CROP_CACHE, exist_ok=True)
    out = os.path.join(_CROP_CACHE, f'{tag}.png')
    if not os.path.exists(out):
        Image.open(src).crop(crop_px).save(out)
    return out


def image(slide, path, x, y, w=None, h=None, frame=True, caption=None, crop_px=None, tag=None):
    """图片卡:按纵横比适配 w/h 之一(或都给则拉伸),细边框 + 可选小字注。"""
    if crop_px:
        path = crop_image(path, crop_px, tag or os.path.basename(path).split('.')[0] + '-crop')
    iw, ih = Image.open(path).size
    if w is not None and h is None:
        h = w * ih / iw
    elif h is not None and w is None:
        w = h * iw / ih
    pic = slide.shapes.add_picture(path, Inches(x), Inches(y), Inches(w), Inches(h))
    pic.shadow.inherit = False
    if frame:
        box(slide, x, y, w, h, fill=None, line=T.LINE, line_w=1.0, radius=0)
    if caption:
        text(slide, x, y + h + 0.03, w, 0.2, caption, size=T.F_TINY, color=T.DIM)
    return pic, w, h


def bullets(slide, x, y, w, title, items, title_color=T.ACCENT, size=T.F_BODY,
            title_size=T.F_H2, gap_after_title=4):
    """要点块:小标题 + 无序列表。items 元素可为 str 或 [(txt, st), ...]。返回文本框。"""
    paras = [[(title, {'size': title_size, 'color': title_color, 'bold': True})]]
    for it in items:
        runs = [(it, {})] if isinstance(it, str) else list(it)
        paras.append([('•  ', {'color': T.DIM})] + runs)
    tb = text(slide, x, y, w, 0.5, paras, size=size, space_after=3)
    tb.text_frame.paragraphs[0].space_after = Pt(gap_after_title)
    return tb


def kpi(slide, x, y, w, value, label, color=T.ACCENT, h=0.78):
    """统计块:大数字 + 小标签。"""
    box(slide, x, y, w, h, fill=T.tint(color, 0.93), line=T.mix(color, 'FFFFFF', 0.6), radius=0.12)
    text(slide, x + 0.08, y + 0.07, w - 0.16, 0.4, value, size=17, color=color, bold=True)
    text(slide, x + 0.08, y + h - 0.31, w - 0.16, 0.26, label, size=T.F_TINY, color=T.DIM)

# DeepSeek-V4

[DeepSeek-V4](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai) is the next-generation MoE language model from DeepSeek
([paper](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash/blob/main/DeepSeek_V4.pdf)). The architecture replaces
DeepSeek-V3's Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) with a hybrid local + long-range design, swaps residual connections
for Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC), and bootstraps the first few MoE layers with a static
token-id → expert-id hash table.

This implementation covers `DeepSeek-V4-Flash`, `DeepSeek-V4-Pro`, and their `-Base` pretrained siblings. All four
share the same architecture; they differ only in width / depth / expert count and weights.

## Architecture (paper §2)

### Hybrid attention (§2.3)

Each decoder block is one of three attention types, dispatched by `config.layer_types[i]`:

* **Sliding-window full attention** (`"sliding_attention"`): only the local window of `sliding_window` tokens, no
  long-range branch. Matches V3's "Full Attention" style for the bootstrap layers.
* **Compressed Sparse Attention** (`"compressed_sparse_attention"`, **CSA** — paper §2.3.1): a low-compression
  pool (`compress_rate_csa`, default `m=4`) with overlapping windows, plus a **Lightning Indexer** (eqs. 13–17)
  that scores queries against the pool and gathers the top `index_topk` blocks per query before they reach core
  attention.
* **Heavily Compressed Attention** (`"heavily_compressed_attention"`, **HCA** — paper §2.3.2): a high-compression
  pool (`compress_rate_hca`, default `m'=128`) with non-overlapping windows. No indexer — every pooled entry
  contributes to attention.

All three types share the same backbone:

* **Shared K=V Multi-Query Attention**: `num_key_value_heads = 1`; `kv_proj` produces a single KV head and the same
  tensor is read as both key and value.
* **Partial RoPE** (interleaved-pair, paper §2.3.3 "Partial Rotary Positional Embedding") on the trailing
  `qk_rope_head_dim = head_dim * partial_rotary_factor` channels of each head. The same rotation is applied with
  position `-i` to the attention output's rope slice (eq. 26) so the contribution of each KV entry stays a function
  of the *relative* distance to the query.
* **Per-head learnable attention sink** (eq. 27).
* **Grouped low-rank output projection** (§2.3.1 "Grouped Output Projection"): `o_groups` head-groups → `o_lora_rank`
  per group → `hidden_size`, computed by `DeepseekV4GroupedLinear` (`o_a_proj`) followed by `o_b_proj`. Cuts the
  per-token cost of the wide attention output without losing expressivity.
* **Shared sliding-window K=V branch** of size `sliding_window` ("Additional Branch of Sliding Window Attention",
  §2.3.1) preserves local fine-grained dependencies; the long-range compressor's output is concatenated with this
  branch's KVs before core attention.

### Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections (§2.2)

Residual connections are replaced by mHC (Xie et al., 2026): `hc_mult` parallel residual streams kept in shape
`[B, S, hc_mult, D]` throughout each block. Two `DeepseekV4HyperConnection` modules — `attn_hc` and `ffn_hc` — mix
streams in and out around the attention / MLP sublayers via a `(pre, post, comb)` triplet. The `comb` matrix is a
doubly-stochastic projection produced by `hc_sinkhorn_iters` Sinkhorn–Knopp iterations on the manifold, making
signal propagation non-expansive across deep stacks. A final `DeepseekV4HyperHead` collapses the `hc_mult`
streams down to a single sequence before the model norm.

### MoE schedule (§2.1)

Routing is configured per layer by `config.mlp_layer_types`, with values from `{"hash_moe", "moe"}`:

* `"hash_moe"`: expert indices come from a frozen `tid2eid[input_ids]` lookup populated from the V4 checkpoint.
  The learned gate `weight` still produces the per-expert scores that weight the selected experts; only
  *which-experts* is static. Used for the first few bootstrap layers (default 3, override via legacy
  `num_hash_layers`).
* `"moe"`: standard top-k routed MoE. The expert affinity uses **Sqrt(Softplus(·))** instead of V3's Sigmoid
  ("we change the activation function that computes the affinity scores from Sigmoid(·) into Sqrt(Softplus(·))",
  paper §2.1), and V3's `n_group` / `topk_group` constraint is dropped. The auxiliary-loss-free strategy
  (DeepSeek's `noaux_tc`) is preserved via the `e_score_correction_bias` buffer that biases the top-k argmax
  without flowing gradients.

Routed experts use a **clamped SwiGLU** (`gate.clamp(max=swiglu_limit)`, `up.clamp(min=-swiglu_limit, max=swiglu_limit)`,
then `act_fn(gate) * up`) on top of the standard Mixtral `[num_experts, 2 * moe_intermediate_size, hidden_size]`
expert weight layout. A single shared expert (a plain SwiGLU MLP at `moe_intermediate_size` width) runs in parallel
on every token.

### Attention mask layout

Each `DeepseekV4Attention` layer extends the standard sliding-window-causal mask along the key axis with a
`block_bias` returned by its compressor, then feeds the concatenated mask to `eager_attention_forward`. The
sliding-section (left, `[S, S]`) is the same for every layer type; the compressor-section (right) differs by
layer type and is the actual "novel" piece introduced by V4.

The diagrams below were produced with a tiny config (`sliding_window=8`, CSA `m=4`, HCA `m'=8`, `index_topk=2`)
on a 16-token input so the full per-layer-type mask fits on screen. Green = the query/key diagonal in the
sliding section, dark = a visible standard KV position, light = masked, amber = a compressor / indexer slot
the query is allowed to attend to. Columns past the dashed line are appended by the compressor via
`cat([sliding_causal_mask, block_bias], dim=-1)`.

**Sliding-only layer (`"sliding_attention"`).** No compressor, no right-padding — the mask is the plain
sliding-window-causal mask of shape `[S, S]` (window = 8). For `i ≥ window` the lower-left triangle is cut
off, recovering the local-only attention pattern.

**CSA layer (`"compressed_sparse_attention"`).** The compressor flattens its per-query gathered output to
`[B, 1, S·k, D]` and right-pads the mask by `S·k` columns. For query `t`, only the `k` slots at columns
`[S + t·k, S + (t+1)·k)` carry the indexer's picks; all other compressor columns are `-inf`. Queries before
the first window has closed (`t < m − 1`) get nothing — the indexer's `-1` sentinel propagates straight to
the mask. As `t` grows, more compressed entries are ready and the indexer can fill all `k` slots.

**HCA layer (`"heavily_compressed_attention"`).** No indexer — every cached compressed entry is potentially
visible. Right-padded by `T_total = entry_count["compressor"]` columns. Query `t` may only see entry `w` once
its source window has closed, i.e. `w < (t + 1) // m`. With `m=8` here, entries 0 (covers positions `0..7`)
and 1 (covers `8..15`) only become visible at `t ≥ 7` and `t ≥ 15` respectively.

These diagrams are reproducible end-to-end via:

```bash
python docs/source/en/imgs/deepseek_v4/visualize_attention_masks.py \
    --svg docs/source/en/imgs/deepseek_v4
```

The script runs a forward pass on this tiny config, wraps each attention layer to capture the exact
post-`cat([attention_mask, block_bias])` mask, remaps CSA's `[S, S·k]` flat-slot mask back to a
`[S, T_entries]` entry-visibility view (so each `C_w` column is a compressed *entry*, not a gather slot),
and writes the three SVGs above. It also prints an ANSI grid to stdout for quick terminal inspection and
dumps the indexer's per-query top-k picks so warm-up sentinels and pick choices are auditable.

### Cache layers

Each non-sliding attention block needs to thread compressor / indexer state across forward calls. V4 ships two
cache layer types that auto-register with `LAYER_TYPE_CACHE_MAPPING`:

* `DeepseekV4HCACache`: sliding-window K=V + HCA compressor buffer / pool / count (no overlap, no indexer).
* `DeepseekV4CSACache`: sliding-window K=V + CSA compressor (with overlap state) + parallel indexer
  buffer / pool / count / overlap at `index_head_dim`.

`DynamicCache(config=…)` builds the right cache layer per `config.layer_types[i]`.

[Source](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/v5.15.1/src/transformers/models/deepseek_v4/configuration_deepseek_v4.py#L40)

**Parameters:**

vocab_size (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `129280`) : Vocabulary size of the model. Defines the number of different tokens that can be represented by the `input_ids`.

hidden_size (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `4096`) : Dimension of the hidden representations.

moe_intermediate_size (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `2048`) : Intermediate size of the routed expert MLPs.

num_hidden_layers (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `43`) : Number of hidden layers in the Transformer decoder.

num_attention_heads (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `64`) : Number of attention heads for each attention layer in the Transformer decoder.

num_key_value_heads (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `1`) : This is the number of key_value heads that should be used to implement Grouped Query Attention. If `num_key_value_heads=num_attention_heads`, the model will use Multi Head Attention (MHA), if `num_key_value_heads=1` the model will use Multi Query Attention (MQA) otherwise GQA is used. When converting a multi-head checkpoint to a GQA checkpoint, each group key and value head should be constructed by meanpooling all the original heads within that group. For more details, check out [this paper](https://huggingface.co/papers/2305.13245). If it is not specified, will default to `num_attention_heads`.

head_dim (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `512`) : The attention head dimension. If None, it will default to hidden_size // num_attention_heads

q_lora_rank (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `1024`) : Rank of the LoRA matrices for query projections.

num_experts_per_tok (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `6`) : Number of experts to route each token to. This is the top-k value for the token-choice routing.

n_routed_experts (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `256`) : Number of routed experts.

n_shared_experts (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `1`) : Number of shared experts.

scoring_func (`str`, *optional*, defaults to `sqrtsoftplus`) : Router activation — `sqrtsoftplus`, `softmax`, or `sigmoid`.

norm_topk_prob (`bool`, *optional*, defaults to `True`) : Whether to normalize the weights of the routed experts. 

routed_scaling_factor (`float`, *optional*, defaults to `1.5`) : Scaling factor or routed experts.

max_position_embeddings (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `1048576`) : The maximum sequence length that this model might ever be used with.

rope_theta (`Union[float, int]`, *optional*, defaults to `10000.0`) : RoPE base for the main self-attention rotary.

layer_types (`list[str]`, *optional*) : Per-layer attention schedule with values from `{"compressed_sparse_attention", "heavily_compressed_attention"}`. V4-Pro default: 2× HCA bootstrap + interleaved CSA / HCA.

compress_rates (`dict[str, int]`) : Per-layer-type compression rate. Default `{"compressed_sparse_attention": 4, "heavily_compressed_attention": 128}` (m=4 for CSA, m'=128 for HCA, paper §2.3.1 / §2.3.2). BC: configs that ship `compress_rate_csa` / `compress_rate_hca` as top-level kwargs are folded in at `__post_init__` time.

compress_rope_theta (`Union[float, int]`, *optional*, defaults to `160000.0`) : RoPE base for the compressed branches (paired with `rope_scaling` for YaRN).

hc_mult (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `4`) : Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connection (mHC) expansion factor n_hc (always active; Section 2.2).

hc_sinkhorn_iters (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `20`) : Sinkhorn-Knopp iterations t_max for the mHC residual mapping projection onto doubly-stochastic matrices.

hc_eps (`float`, *optional*, defaults to `1e-06`) : Numerical floor for the Sinkhorn-Knopp normalization.

mlp_layer_types (`list[str]`, *optional*) : Per-layer MoE schedule with values from `{"hash_moe", "moe"}`. `hash_moe` routes via a frozen `tid2eid[input_ids]` lookup (paper §2.1, "Hash-MoE bootstrap"); `moe` is the standard top-k routed MoE. Default: 3× `hash_moe` then `moe` for the rest. BC: legacy configs that ship `num_hash_layers` as a top-level kwarg are folded in at `__post_init__` time.

swiglu_limit (`float`, *optional*, defaults to `10.0`) : Clip routed experts' gate/up pre-activations.

sliding_window (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `128`) : Local window size n_win used in every attention block's sliding-window branch.

o_groups (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `8`) : Number of head-groups g in the grouped output projection (paper §2.3.1, "Grouped Output Projection").

o_lora_rank (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `1024`) : Per-group intermediate dim d_g in the grouped output projection.

index_n_heads (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `64`) : Number of indexer query heads n_h^I (paper §2.3.1, eq. 14).

index_head_dim (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `128`) : Indexer head dim c^I (paper §2.3.1).

index_topk (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `512`) : Number of compressed entries per query the Lightning Indexer keeps via top-k (paper §2.3.1, eq. 17).

num_nextn_predict_layers (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `1`) : MTP layer count in the upstream checkpoint (not instantiated here).

output_router_logits (`bool`, *optional*, defaults to `False`) : Whether or not the router logits should be returned by the model. Enabling this will also allow the model to output the auxiliary loss, including load balancing loss and router z-loss.

router_aux_loss_coef (`float`, *optional*, defaults to `0.001`) : Auxiliary load balancing loss coefficient. Used to penalize uneven expert routing in MoE models.

router_jitter_noise (`float`, *optional*, defaults to `0.0`) : Amount of noise to add to the router logits during training for better load balancing.

hidden_act (`str`, *optional*, defaults to `silu`) : The non-linear activation function (function or string) in the decoder. For example, `"gelu"`, `"relu"`, `"silu"`, etc.

initializer_range (`float`, *optional*, defaults to `0.02`) : The standard deviation of the truncated_normal_initializer for initializing all weight matrices.

rms_norm_eps (`float`, *optional*, defaults to `1e-06`) : The epsilon used by the rms normalization layers.

use_cache (`bool`, *optional*, defaults to `True`) : Whether or not the model should return the last key/values attentions (not used by all models). Only relevant if `config.is_decoder=True` or when the model is a decoder-only generative model.

pad_token_id (`int`, *optional*) : Token id used for padding in the vocabulary.

bos_token_id (`int`, *optional*, defaults to `0`) : Token id used for beginning-of-stream in the vocabulary.

eos_token_id (`Union[int, list[int]]`, *optional*, defaults to `1`) : Token id used for end-of-stream in the vocabulary.

tie_word_embeddings (`bool`, *optional*, defaults to `False`) : Whether to tie weight embeddings according to model's `tied_weights_keys` mapping.

rope_parameters (`Union[~modeling_rope_utils.RopeParameters, dict]`, *optional*) : Dictionary containing the configuration parameters for the RoPE embeddings. The dictionary should contain a value for `rope_theta` and optionally parameters used for scaling in case you want to use RoPE with longer `max_position_embeddings`.

partial_rotary_factor (`float`, *optional*) : Fraction of head_dim that gets RoPE. Defaults to `qk_rope_head_dim / head_dim` so cos/sin sizes to `qk_rope_head_dim`.

attention_bias (`bool`, *optional*, defaults to `False`) : Whether to use a bias in the query, key, value and output projection layers during self-attention.

mlp_bias (`bool`, *optional*, defaults to `False`) : Whether to use a bias in up_proj, down_proj and gate_proj layers in the MLP layers.

attention_dropout (`float`, *optional*, defaults to `0.0`) : The dropout ratio for the attention probabilities.

This is the configuration class to store the configuration of a DeepseekV4Model. It is used to instantiate a Deepseek V4
model according to the specified arguments, defining the model architecture. Instantiating a configuration with the
defaults will yield a similar configuration to that of the [deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base)

Configuration objects inherit from [PreTrainedConfig](/docs/transformers/v5.15.1/en/main_classes/configuration#transformers.PreTrainedConfig) and can be used to control the model outputs. Read the
documentation from [PreTrainedConfig](/docs/transformers/v5.15.1/en/main_classes/configuration#transformers.PreTrainedConfig) for more information.

#### validate_layer_type[[transformers.DeepseekV4Config.validate_layer_type]]

```python
validate_layer_type()
```

[Source](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/v5.15.1/src/transformers/models/deepseek_v4/configuration_deepseek_v4.py#L225)

V4 narrows the global `ALLOWED_LAYER_TYPES` to the three attention-block
types and two MLP-block types it actually ships with, on top of the standard
length / type-membership checks.

```python
forward(input_ids: typing.Optional[torch.LongTensor] = None, attention_mask: typing.Optional[torch.Tensor] = None, position_ids: typing.Optional[torch.LongTensor] = None, past_key_values: transformers.cache_utils.Cache | None = None, inputs_embeds: typing.Optional[torch.FloatTensor] = None, use_cache: bool | None = None, **kwargs: Unpack)

**Parameters:**

input_ids (`torch.LongTensor` of shape `(batch_size, sequence_length)`, *optional*) : Indices of input sequence tokens in the vocabulary. Padding will be ignored by default.  Indices can be obtained using [AutoTokenizer](/docs/transformers/v5.15.1/en/model_doc/auto#transformers.AutoTokenizer). See [PreTrainedTokenizer.encode()](/docs/transformers/v5.15.1/en/internal/tokenization_utils#transformers.PreTrainedTokenizerBase.encode) and [PreTrainedTokenizer.__call__()](/docs/transformers/v5.15.1/en/internal/tokenization_utils#transformers.PreTrainedTokenizerBase.__call__) for details.  [What are input IDs?](../glossary#input-ids)

attention_mask (`torch.Tensor` of shape `(batch_size, sequence_length)`, *optional*) : Mask to avoid performing attention on padding token indices. Mask values selected in `[0, 1]`:  - 1 for tokens that are **not masked**, - 0 for tokens that are **masked**.  [What are attention masks?](../glossary#attention-mask)

position_ids (`torch.LongTensor` of shape `(batch_size, sequence_length)`, *optional*) : Indices of positions of each input sequence tokens in the position embeddings. Selected in the range `[0, config.n_positions - 1]`.  [What are position IDs?](../glossary#position-ids)

past_key_values (`~cache_utils.Cache`, *optional*) : Pre-computed hidden-states (key and values in the self-attention blocks and in the cross-attention blocks) that can be used to speed up sequential decoding. This typically consists in the `past_key_values` returned by the model at a previous stage of decoding, when `use_cache=True` or `config.use_cache=True`.  Only [Cache](/docs/transformers/v5.15.1/en/internal/generation_utils#transformers.Cache) instance is allowed as input, see our [kv cache guide](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/en/kv_cache). If no `past_key_values` are passed, [DynamicCache](/docs/transformers/v5.15.1/en/internal/generation_utils#transformers.DynamicCache) will be initialized by default.  The model will output the same cache format that is fed as input.  If `past_key_values` are used, the user is expected to input only unprocessed `input_ids` (those that don't have their past key value states given to this model) of shape `(batch_size, unprocessed_length)` instead of all `input_ids` of shape `(batch_size, sequence_length)`.

inputs_embeds (`torch.FloatTensor` of shape `(batch_size, sequence_length, hidden_size)`, *optional*) : Optionally, instead of passing `input_ids` you can choose to directly pass an embedded representation. This is useful if you want more control over how to convert `input_ids` indices into associated vectors than the model's internal embedding lookup matrix.

use_cache (`bool`, *optional*) : If set to `True`, `past_key_values` key value states are returned and can be used to speed up decoding (see `past_key_values`).

**Returns:** `MoeModelOutputWithPast` or `tuple(torch.FloatTensor)`

A `MoeModelOutputWithPast` or a tuple of
`torch.FloatTensor` (if `return_dict=False` is passed or when `config.return_dict=False`) comprising various
elements depending on the configuration ([DeepseekV4Config](/docs/transformers/v5.15.1/en/model_doc/deepseek_v4#transformers.DeepseekV4Config)) and inputs.

The [DeepseekV4Model](/docs/transformers/v5.15.1/en/model_doc/deepseek_v4#transformers.DeepseekV4Model) forward method, overrides the `__call__` special method.

Although the recipe for forward pass needs to be defined within this function, one should call the `Module`
instance afterwards instead of this since the former takes care of running the pre and post processing steps while
the latter silently ignores them.

- **last_hidden_state** (`torch.FloatTensor` of shape `(batch_size, sequence_length, hidden_size)`) -- Sequence of hidden-states at the output of the last layer of the model.
- **past_key_values** (`Cache`, *optional*, returned when `use_cache=True` is passed or when `config.use_cache=True`) -- It is a [Cache](/docs/transformers/v5.15.1/en/internal/generation_utils#transformers.Cache) instance. For more details, see our [kv cache guide](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/en/kv_cache).

  Contains pre-computed hidden-states (key and values in the self-attention blocks and optionally if
  `config.is_encoder_decoder=True` in the cross-attention blocks) that can be used (see `past_key_values`
  input) to speed up sequential decoding.
- **hidden_states** (`tuple(torch.FloatTensor)`, *optional*, returned when `output_hidden_states=True` is passed or when `config.output_hidden_states=True`) -- Tuple of `torch.FloatTensor` (one for the output of the embeddings, if the model has an embedding layer, +
  one for the output of each layer) of shape `(batch_size, sequence_length, hidden_size)`.

  Hidden-states of the model at the output of each layer plus the optional initial embedding outputs.
- **attentions** (`tuple(torch.FloatTensor)`, *optional*, returned when `output_attentions=True` is passed or when `config.output_attentions=True`) -- Tuple of `torch.FloatTensor` (one for each layer) of shape `(batch_size, num_heads, sequence_length,
  sequence_length)`.

  Attentions weights after the attention softmax, used to compute the weighted average in the self-attention
  heads.
- **router_logits** (`tuple(torch.FloatTensor)`, *optional*, returned when `output_router_probs=True` and `config.add_router_probs=True` is passed or when `config.output_router_probs=True`) -- Tuple of `torch.FloatTensor` (one for each layer) of shape `(batch_size, sequence_length, num_experts)`.

  Raw router logits (post-softmax) that are computed by MoE routers, these terms are used to compute the auxiliary
  loss for Mixture of Experts models.

attention_mask (`torch.Tensor` of shape `(batch_size, sequence_length)`, *optional*) : Mask to avoid performing attention on padding token indices. Mask values selected in `[0, 1]`:  - 1 for tokens that are **not masked**, - 0 for tokens that are **masked**.  [What are attention masks?](../glossary#attention-mask)

position_ids (`torch.LongTensor` of shape `(batch_size, sequence_length)`, *optional*) : Indices of positions of each input sequence tokens in the position embeddings. Selected in the range `[0, config.n_positions - 1]`.  [What are position IDs?](../glossary#position-ids)

past_key_values (`~cache_utils.Cache`, *optional*) : Pre-computed hidden-states (key and values in the self-attention blocks and in the cross-attention blocks) that can be used to speed up sequential decoding. This typically consists in the `past_key_values` returned by the model at a previous stage of decoding, when `use_cache=True` or `config.use_cache=True`.  Only [Cache](/docs/transformers/v5.15.1/en/internal/generation_utils#transformers.Cache) instance is allowed as input, see our [kv cache guide](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/en/kv_cache). If no `past_key_values` are passed, [DynamicCache](/docs/transformers/v5.15.1/en/internal/generation_utils#transformers.DynamicCache) will be initialized by default.  The model will output the same cache format that is fed as input.  If `past_key_values` are used, the user is expected to input only unprocessed `input_ids` (those that don't have their past key value states given to this model) of shape `(batch_size, unprocessed_length)` instead of all `input_ids` of shape `(batch_size, sequence_length)`.

inputs_embeds (`torch.FloatTensor` of shape `(batch_size, sequence_length, hidden_size)`, *optional*) : Optionally, instead of passing `input_ids` you can choose to directly pass an embedded representation. This is useful if you want more control over how to convert `input_ids` indices into associated vectors than the model's internal embedding lookup matrix.

labels (`torch.LongTensor` of shape `(batch_size, sequence_length)`, *optional*) : Labels for computing the masked language modeling loss. Indices should either be in `[0, ..., config.vocab_size]` or -100 (see `input_ids` docstring). Tokens with indices set to `-100` are ignored (masked), the loss is only computed for the tokens with labels in `[0, ..., config.vocab_size]`.

use_cache (`bool`, *optional*) : If set to `True`, `past_key_values` key value states are returned and can be used to speed up decoding (see `past_key_values`).

output_router_logits (`bool`, *optional*) : Whether or not to return the logits of all the routers. They are useful for computing the router loss, and should not be returned during inference.

logits_to_keep (`Union[int, torch.Tensor]`, *optional*, defaults to `0`) : If an `int`, compute logits for the last `logits_to_keep` tokens. If `0`, calculate logits for all `input_ids` (special case). Only last token logits are needed for generation, and calculating them only for that token can save memory, which becomes pretty significant for long sequences or large vocabulary size. If a `torch.Tensor`, must be 1D corresponding to the indices to keep in the sequence length dimension. This is useful when using packed tensor format (single dimension for batch and sequence length).

**Returns:** `MoeCausalLMOutputWithPast` or `tuple(torch.FloatTensor)`

A `MoeCausalLMOutputWithPast` or a tuple of
`torch.FloatTensor` (if `return_dict=False` is passed or when `config.return_dict=False`) comprising various
elements depending on the configuration ([DeepseekV4Config](/docs/transformers/v5.15.1/en/model_doc/deepseek_v4#transformers.DeepseekV4Config)) and inputs.

The [DeepseekV4ForCausalLM](/docs/transformers/v5.15.1/en/model_doc/deepseek_v4#transformers.DeepseekV4ForCausalLM) forward method, overrides the `__call__` special method.

Although the recipe for forward pass needs to be defined within this function, one should call the `Module`
instance afterwards instead of this since the former takes care of running the pre and post processing steps while
the latter silently ignores them.

- **loss** (`torch.FloatTensor` of shape `(1,)`, *optional*, returned when `labels` is provided) -- Language modeling loss (for next-token prediction).
- **logits** (`torch.FloatTensor` of shape `(batch_size, sequence_length, config.vocab_size)`) -- Prediction scores of the language modeling head (scores for each vocabulary token before SoftMax).
- **aux_loss** (`torch.FloatTensor`, *optional*, returned when `labels` is provided) -- aux_loss for the sparse modules.
- **router_logits** (`tuple(torch.FloatTensor)`, *optional*, returned when `output_router_probs=True` and `config.add_router_probs=True` is passed or when `config.output_router_probs=True`) -- Tuple of `torch.FloatTensor` (one for each layer) of shape `(batch_size, sequence_length, num_experts)`.

  Raw router logits (post-softmax) that are computed by MoE routers, these terms are used to compute the auxiliary
  loss for Mixture of Experts models.
- **past_key_values** (`Cache`, *optional*, returned when `use_cache=True` is passed or when `config.use_cache=True`) -- It is a [Cache](/docs/transformers/v5.15.1/en/internal/generation_utils#transformers.Cache) instance. For more details, see our [kv cache guide](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/en/kv_cache).

  Contains pre-computed hidden-states (key and values in the self-attention blocks) that can be used (see
  `past_key_values` input) to speed up sequential decoding.
- **hidden_states** (`tuple(torch.FloatTensor)`, *optional*, returned when `output_hidden_states=True` is passed or when `config.output_hidden_states=True`) -- Tuple of `torch.FloatTensor` (one for the output of the embeddings, if the model has an embedding layer, +
  one for the output of each layer) of shape `(batch_size, sequence_length, hidden_size)`.

  Hidden-states of the model at the output of each layer plus the optional initial embedding outputs.
- **attentions** (`tuple(torch.FloatTensor)`, *optional*, returned when `output_attentions=True` is passed or when `config.output_attentions=True`) -- Tuple of `torch.FloatTensor` (one for each layer) of shape `(batch_size, num_heads, sequence_length,
  sequence_length)`.

  Attentions weights after the attention softmax, used to compute the weighted average in the self-attention
  heads.

Example:

```python
>>> from transformers import AutoTokenizer, DeepseekV4ForCausalLM

>>> model = DeepseekV4ForCausalLM.from_pretrained("mistralai/DeepseekV4-8x7B-v0.1")
>>> tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("mistralai/DeepseekV4-8x7B-v0.1")

>>> prompt = "Hey, are you conscious? Can you talk to me?"
>>> inputs = tokenizer(prompt, return_tensors="pt")

>>> # Generate
>>> generate_ids = model.generate(inputs.input_ids, max_length=30)
>>> tokenizer.batch_decode(generate_ids, skip_special_tokens=True, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False)[0]
"Hey, are you conscious? Can you talk to me?\nI'm not conscious, but I can talk to you."
```

Based on the search results, here's what I found about Kimi K3's Moonshot release date and licensing:

## Release Date

Moonshot AI released Kimi K3 on July 16, 2026, via its apps and API. The full open weights were published on Hugging Face on July 27, 2026.

## License

The licensing situation for Kimi K3 is nuanced. While earlier reporting predicted a "modified MIT" license similar to K2, the licence is a bespoke Kimi K3 License rather than the Modified MIT that the K2 family used and that most pre-release coverage predicted, and its revenue-triggered conditions mean it would not qualify under the Open Source Initiative definition.

The full weights shipped on July 27, 2026, under the "Kimi K3 License" — a modified MIT license allowing free commercial use, modification, distribution, and fine-tuning. The one condition beyond attribution: if you operate a "Model as a Service" business with over $20M in revenue across any 12 months, you must sign a separate agreement with Moonshot before commercial use.

It's important to note that it is open-weight, which is not the same as open source. Moonshot published the full 1.56 TB checkpoint on July 27, 2026, so anyone can download, run, and fine-tune it.

"""页面骨架:每页五要素(节标签 / 页题 / 副题 / 页脚 / 来源角标)+ notes。"""
from __future__ import annotations

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches

from . import kit as K
from . import theme as T

SECTION_COLOR = {
    '一': T.ACCENT, '二': T.BLUE, '三': T.ACCENT2, '四': T.CYAN, '五': T.SLATE,
}


def new_deck() -> Presentation:
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = Inches(T.SLIDE_W)
    prs.slide_height = Inches(T.SLIDE_H)
    return prs


def add_page(prs, title, subtitle=None, section=None, sources=None):
    """新建空版式页并画骨架。返回 slide。

    section: 如 '第一部分 · 方向与范围'(首字定色);sources: list[str]。
    """
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    page_no = len(prs.slides.._length if False else prs.slides._sldIdLst)  # noqa: 占位,下行修正
    page_no = len(prs.slides._sldIdLst)
    x = T.MARGIN

    color = T.ACCENT
    if section:
        for key, c in SECTION_COLOR.items():
            if f'第{key}部分' in section:
                color = c
                break
        K.chip(slide, x, 0.24, section, color=color, size=T.F_SECTION, h=0.26)
    # 题区
    K.text(slide, x, 0.52, T.CONTENT_W - 1.2, 0.5, title, size=T.F_TITLE, bold=True)
    if subtitle:
        K.text(slide, x, 0.90, T.CONTENT_W, 0.28, subtitle, size=T.F_SUB, color=T.DIM)
    K.line(slide, x, T.CONTENT_TOP - 0.05, T.SLIDE_W - T.MARGIN, T.CONTENT_TOP - 0.05,
           color=T.LINE, width=1.0)
    # 页脚
    fy = T.SLIDE_H - 0.34
    K.line(slide, x, fy, T.SLIDE_W - T.MARGIN, fy, color=T.LINE, width=0.75)
    K.text(slide, x, fy + 0.04, 6.0, 0.24, f'{T.FOOTER_LEFT} · {T.DECK_DATE}',
           size=T.F_TINY, color=T.DIM)
    K.text(slide, T.SLIDE_W - T.MARGIN - 1.0, fy + 0.04, 1.0, 0.24, f'{page_no:02d}',
           size=T.F_TINY, color=T.DIM, align='r')
    if sources:
        K.text(slide, T.MARGIN, fy - 0.22, T.CONTENT_W, 0.2,
               '来源:' + ' ; '.join(sources), size=T.F_TINY, color=T.mix(T.DIM, 'FFFFFF', 0.25),
               align='r')
    return slide


def set_notes(slide, notes_text: str):
    slide.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = notes_text or ''

```

"""构建入口:python build.py [页名...] → out/aifactory-deck.pptx

页名缺省用 PAGES 全序;传子集(如 `python build.py p01_goals`)只出样张。
"""
import importlib
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))

from template import master  # noqa: E402

# 18 页全序;逐页落地后往里加
PAGES = [
    'p01_goals',
    'p03_architecture',
    'p06_platforms',
]


def main():
    names = sys.argv[1:] or PAGES
    prs = master.new_deck()
    for name in names:
        mod = importlib.import_module(f'content.{name}')
        slide = master.add_page(prs, **mod.META)
        mod.render(slide)
        master.set_notes(slide, getattr(mod, 'NOTES', ''))
        print(f'  + {name}')
    os.makedirs('out', exist_ok=True)
    suffix = '' if names == PAGES else '-sample'
    out = f'out/aifactory-deck{suffix}.pptx'
    prs.save(out)
    print(f'saved {out} ({len(names)} slides)')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```

# A2 — 2026 开源大模型 NVIDIA 平台推理部署配置与性能数据

> 收集日期:2026-09-03。全部来源为公开网页(访问日期均为 2026-09-03)。
> 口径说明:TTFT = time to first token;TPOT/ITL = 每输出 token 时延;tok/s/GPU = 系统吞吐/GPU 数;tok/s/user = 单请求解码速度。
> 托管商数据(Artificial Analysis 口径)对 reasoning 模型的 TTFT **含思考时间**,与引擎层 TTFT 不可直接对比。
> 查不到的数据标 `null`,未编造任何数字。

## 4. DeepSeek-V4-Pro(1.6T 总参 / 49B 激活,MoE;1M 上下文;mHC)

### 4.1 官方/半官方部署配置

| 来源 | 硬件 | 并行策略 | 量化 | 上下文 | 投机解码 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| vLLM 官方 recipe | B300×8 单节点(`--data-parallel-size 8`);H200×8(DP+EP,上下文封顶 800K);GB200 需 2 个 NVL4 tray(8 GPU,多节点 DP+EP);MI355X×8 | DP+EP 为主;MI355X TP8 | FP8(0813)默认;"FP4+FP8 mixed"(专家 FP4、注意力/router FP8,checkpoint ~960GB);NVFP4(Blackwell);KV FP8 | 1M(H200 800K) | DSpark 默认(7 token,probabilistic);MTP 可选(3 token) |
| NVIDIA Dynamo recipes(GitHub ai-dynamo/dynamo) | GB200 目标,vLLM 与 SGLang 双后端 | 聚合 TP8 跨 tray,或 PD 分离 | 同上 | — | — |

### 4.2 吞吐-延迟数据(重点:NVL72 wide-EP)

| 硬件 | 条件 | 数据 | 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| GB300 NVL72 vs GB200 NVL72(Dynamo+vLLM,FP4,8K/1K,PD 分离) | iso-interactivity 27 tok/s/user | GB300: **6182 tok/s/GPU**(~$0.12/M);GB200: 2189 tok/s/GPU(~$0.28/M)→ **2.83× 吞吐 / 2.31× 成本优势**;GB300 decode 可开到 EP=16、prefill TP4-8 | SemiAnalysis InferenceX |
| GB300 NVL72(Dynamo+SGLang,PD 分离 + MTP) | ~50 tok/s/user,2026-06 | **~11,200 tok/s/GPU**(day-0 四月栈仅 ~2200)→ 43 天 ~5× 纯软件提升;$0.156/M 输出 token | SemiAnalysis day0-43 |
| GB300 NVL72 | 75 tok/s/user | 60,053 tok/s/chip 口径数据(InferenceX 对比页,含 $0.01/M 标注,口径待核) | InferenceX 对比页 |
| B200 | 50 tok/s/user | tokens/MW 从 ~30 万提到 ~50 万(day-0→6/5,纯软件) | SemiAnalysis day0-43 |
| GB300 NVL72 perf/W | 160 tok/s/user | 对 H200 NVL8: 15× throughput/MW、10× 更低 $/M token;Vera Rubin NVL72 preview 再 30× | NVIDIA 官方博客 |

wide-EP 关键机制(可复述):GB300 288GB HBM 解除并发内存约束,decode 由 EP=8 拓宽到 **EP=16**(最大并发 16,384→21,504),配合 4–12 prefill worker/decode worker 与 MegaMoE 融合内核(理论 1.92× vs naive)。

## 6. 可引用的行业案例(售前 slide 用,p5-1/2/3 与 PoC 页)

1. **软件栈复利(PoC 页核心论据)**:同一套 GB300 NVL72 硬件上,DeepSeek-V4-Pro 1.6T 的推理吞吐 43 天内从 ~2,200 提升到 **~11,200 tok/s/GPU**(50 tok/s/user,Dynamo+SGLang PD 分离 + MTP),纯软件优化 ~5×,输出成本降至 $0.156/M token。—— SemiAnalysis InferenceX (https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/blog/deepseekv4-16t-day-0-to-day-43-performance)
2. **wide-EP 是 NVL72 的核心杠杆(p5 架构页)**:GB300 288GB HBM 让 decode EP 从 8 拓宽到 16,同等交互性下对 GB200 NVL72 达 **2.83× tok/s/GPU、2.31× 每 token 成本优势**(V4-Pro FP4,Dynamo+vLLM,PD 分离)。—— SemiAnalysis (https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/blog/gb300-nvl72-vs-gb200-nvl72-dsv4-pro-vllm-fp4)
3. **万亿级 MoE 的代际经济性(TCO 页)**:NVIDIA 官方口径,GB300 NVL72 对 H200 NVL8 在 DeepSeek V4-Pro 上 **15× throughput/MW、10× 更低 $/M token**;在 Kimi K3 2.8T 上达 **80× throughput/MW**(110–160 tok/s/user 档)。—— NVIDIA 技术博客 (https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-vera-rubin-and-blackwell-set-a-new-standard-for-agentic-ai-performance-per-watt/)
4. **2.8T 模型单机架落地(p5-2 案例)**:Kimi-K3 凭 MXFP4 QAT 在 8×B300 单节点即可服务(~196GB/GPU,527K 有效上下文,30 并发下 TTFT 中位 746ms);vLLM 官方在 GB300 上 DSpark 投机解码把单流解码从 118 提至 **370 tok/s/user(3.14×)**。—— Fixstars (https://blog.us.fixstars.com/deploying-kimi-k3-on-day-0-can-a-2-8t-model-run-on-a-single-node-of-nvidia-b300-x8/)、vLLM (https://vllm.ai/blog/2026-07-27-k3)
5. **中档 MoE 的低门槛(p5-3 案例)**:GLM-5.2 753B 用 NVFP4 在 **4×B200 聚合部署**即达 176.4 tok/s/GPU 系统吞吐、TTFT P50 355ms(64 并发,Dynamo+SGLang,MTP 接受长度 2.69);GLM-5.3 在 GB300 单流 556 tok/s、bs=256 节点 7,501 tok/s。—— NVIDIA Dynamo (https://docs.nvidia.com/dynamo/v1.4.0/recipes/glm-5-2)、SGLang (https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/GLM/GLM-5.3)
6. **托管商差距即优化空间(商务页)**:同为 DeepSeek-V4-Pro,Fireworks 167 tok/s vs 其余 provider 33–41 tok/s(AA 口径,10K 输入);GLM-5.2 上 Fireworks 314.9 tok/s vs 一方 API 115.2 tok/s——说明推理工程能力本身就是 3–5× 的差异化。—— DeepInfra 博客转述 AA 数据 (https://deepinfra.com/blog/deepseek-v4-pro-max-api-benchmarks-latency-throughput-cost 、https://deepinfra.com/blog/best-glm-5-2-max-api-providers)

## Official "11x" Inference Performance

NVIDIA cites that HGX B300 NVL16 can achieve up to 11× faster LLM inference and up to 7× more compute versus Hopper-generation systems. More specifically, HGX B300 achieves up to 11x higher inference performance over the previous H100 generation for models such as Llama 3.1 405B.

## Trillion-Parameter Model Support

The HGX B300 NVL16 platform is a major leap in AI infrastructure, engineered for trillion-parameter model training, large-scale inference, and reasoning workloads. The system includes 8 NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs per node (about 2.3 TB total HBM3e) with 11x faster inference on large language models, 7x more compute, and 4x larger memory compared with the Hopper generation.

## Memory for Large Models

For trillion-parameter models specifically, for a quantized trillion-parameter model at FP4 — about 500 GB of weights — the entire model fits across just 2 GPUs, leaving 70 GPUs available for KV-cache, activations, and concurrent reasoning passes when using the larger GB300 NVL72 rack system.

# A5 — 业界参考架构调研(售前 deck p3/p4)

调研日期:2026-09-03。目的:对照 NVIDIA Dynamo / SGLang / vLLM / Fireworks / K8s 生态 / 云厂商 MaaS,修正并背书用户草案的 p3 分层架构与 p4 推理逻辑架构;附各技术点公开 benchmark 收益数据(进 notes)。

---

## 1. p3 整体分层架构:建议分层与草案修正

业界对照基准:NVIDIA Enterprise Reference Architecture(ERA)/ Enterprise AI Factory Validated Design 的全栈叫法是「设施 → 加速基础设施(NVIDIA-Certified 服务器 + Spectrum-X 网络 + BlueField)→ K8s/集群管理 → AI Enterprise 软件(NIM/框架/SDK)→ 应用」;三种工厂配置:RTX PRO / HGX / NVL72 AI Factory。用户的六横层与之高度兼容,建议如下(自上而下):

| # | 推荐命名 | 职责 | 代表组件 | 对用户草案的修正 |
|---|---------|------|---------|----------------|
| L1 | 应用与 Agent 层(AI Applications & Agents) | 行业应用、Agent 编排、RAG/工具调用 | NIM/NeMo、Agent 框架、行业 ISV | 无偏差。NVIDIA 叫「application layer(AI frameworks + NIM microservices + SDKs)」,可加「Agentic」字样贴 2026 语境 |
| L2 | 全球流量与容量调度层(Global Traffic & Capacity Scheduling,cluster level) | 跨地域/跨集群路由、就近接入、容量配置、灾备 | Fireworks Virtual Cloud scheduler(8 云 18+ region)、云厂商全球 endpoint | 方向正确但要注明:单 DC 参考架构(NVIDIA ERA)不含此层,它是「多集群 MaaS 运营商」特有层——Fireworks 是最好的公开背书。命名避免只写「流量」,业界含容量调度(global locality / autoscaling / compliance / DR) |
| L3 | AI 网关与推理路由层(AI Gateway & Inference Routing,worker level) | 认证/配额/计费/模型级路由(网关)+ cache-aware/load-aware 端点选择(路由) | K8s Gateway API Inference Extension(Inference Gateway + EPP/inference scheduler)、kgateway、Envoy AI Gateway、llm-d inference-scheduler、AIBrix Gateway、Dynamo Frontend(API Server)+ Smart Router | 修正 1:业界把「网关(模型级,南北向)」与「智能路由/调度器(端点级,cache/load/SLO-aware)」分成两个组件,同层可以,但图上应画成两个框。修正 2:K8s 现行标准形态就是 Gateway API Inference Extension(2025 年 K8s 官方发布),llm-d/AIBrix 都构建其上——deck 可直接引用该名 |
| L4 | 推理 Serving 层(Inference Serving,model instance level) | 引擎调度、批处理、并行、KV 管理、P/D worker | SGLang、vLLM、TensorRT-LLM;Dynamo 的 prefill/decode workers | 无偏差。建议标注引擎之上还有「分布式推理框架」(Dynamo/llm-d/AIBrix)这一胶水层,它跨 L3-L4 |
| L5 | 加速基础设施层(Accelerated Infrastructure:计算/网络/存储) | GPU 服务器、参考网络(scale-up/scale-out)、存储 | NVIDIA-Certified 服务器(HGX/NVL72)、Spectrum-X/InfiniBand、BlueField DPU | 用户叫「资源层」可以,但对客户建议用 NVIDIA ERA 的「accelerated infrastructure」措辞,并列出计算/网络/存储三件套 |
| L6 | 设施层(Facility:电力/冷却/机房) | 供电、液冷、机柜、DC 基建 | NVIDIA AI Factory 设计中的 facility/hardware infrastructure 篇 | 无偏差,NVIDIA AI Factory 白皮书同样把设施独立成篇 |

**四纵柱修正**:
- 安全 ✓、可观测 ✓ ——NVIDIA ERA 与 llm-d 均将 observability/security 列为贯穿项,无偏差。
- 「性能仿真评估」→ 建议改名「**性能建模与容量规划**(Performance Modeling & Capacity Planning)」:业界对应物是 Dynamo Planner 的 profiling/SLA 规划、Fireworks FireOptimizer(84,000+ 部署组合寻优)。「仿真」一词客户易误解为数字孪生。
- 「高可用扩缩容(Planner)」→ 建议叫「**SLO 驱动的弹性与高可用**」:Dynamo Planner 的官方定位正是「监控容量与 prefill 活动、按 SLO 动态调 GPU 配比(零停机)」;AIBrix 有 LLM-specific autoscaler(按 KV 利用率等推理感知指标扩缩)。把 Planner 放这根柱是对的,但 Planner 同时覆盖上面那根「性能建模」柱(profiling→规划→执行闭环),图上可两柱共享。
- **K8s 与软件平台**:业界(ERA/llm-d/AIBrix)把 K8s + GPU Operator + 集群管理画为 L4 与 L5 之间的水平「平台层」,不是纵柱——建议画成 L4.5 横条。

**云厂商 MaaS 术语验证**:「serverless API(按 token 付费)+ 专属容量」是行业标准二分法,专属容量的官方名:AWS Bedrock「Provisioned Throughput」、Azure AI Foundry「Provisioned Throughput Units(PTU)」、Google Vertex AI「Provisioned Throughput(以 GSU 计)」。用户的「serverless API + 专属 MaaS(provisioned throughput)」表述**成立**,建议直接用「Provisioned Throughput」英文原词。

---

## 2. p4 推理服务逻辑架构:组件链与 SLA 映射

参照 NVIDIA Dynamo 官方架构(API Server → Smart Router → P/D Workers,Planner + KVBM + NIXL 为支撑面)重排用户组件:

```
Client
 └→ ① AI Gateway / Frontend(OpenAI 兼容 API、认证配额、模型级路由)
     └→ ② Smart Router(cache-aware:全局 radix-tree 命中率 + load-aware 负载均衡)
         └→ ③ Worker Pool(多模型实例)
             ├→ ③a Prefill Workers ──KV 经 ⑥ 传输──→ ③b Decode Workers   [PD 分离,agg/disagg 可切]
             │      并行策略:TP / PP / EP(wide-EP + DeepEP)/ DP attention / DCP
             └→ ④ 多级 KV Cache(GPU HBM → CPU DRAM → SSD → 远端存储池)
                    实现:Dynamo KVBM / SGLang HiCache / LMCache / Mooncake Store
 支撑面:⑤ Planner(SLO 驱动 P/D 配比与扩缩) ⑥ 传输层(NIXL / Mooncake Transfer Engine, RDMA)
 引擎内技术:continuous batching、chunked prefill、quantization(FP8/NVFP4)、MTP/投机解码(DSpark)
```

各组件 → SLA 指标映射(建议标在图上):

| 组件 | TTFT | TPOT | 吞吐 | 成本 | 依据 |
|------|------|------|------|------|------|
| ① Gateway | 微增(ms 级) | — | — | 配额/计费治理 | GAIE 定位 |
| ② Smart Router | ↓↓(命中缓存免重算) | — | ↑ | ↑利用率 | llm-d/GAIE 智能路由 benchmark:TTFT 最多 3x 改善、SLO 约束下吞吐 2x |
| ③a Prefill worker | 决定 TTFT | — | ↑(P/D 独立扩) | 按输入长扩容 | DistServe/Dynamo |
| ③b Decode worker | — | 决定 TPOT | ↑ | 按并发扩容 | 同上 |
| 并行策略 | EP/DCP 影响 | ↓(DCP/EP) | ↑↑ | ↓单 token 成本 | LMSYS wide-EP、vLLM DCP |
| ④ 多级 KV | ↓↓(多轮/长前缀) | — | ↑ | 用便宜介质换 GPU 重算 | Mooncake/LMCache/HiCache |
| ⑤ Planner | 保 SLO | 保 SLO | goodput↑ | 防过度供给 | Dynamo Planner |
| ⑥ NIXL 传输 | 决定 disagg 可行性 | — | — | — | Dynamo NIXL |

**草案修正点**:
1. Router 的「cache-aware」官方措辞:SGLang router 政策叫 `cache_aware`(另有 random/round-robin/power-of-two);Dynamo 叫「KV cache-aware routing(全局 radix tree 记录命中率,兼顾负载)」。PD 分离下 SGLang router 还做 DP-aware 的 P/D 双边一致路由——图上 Router 应同时指向 P 池和 D 池。
2. 「DeepEP」是通信库不是并行策略,并行策略叫 wide-EP / large-scale EP,DeepEP 是其 dispatch/combine 实现(prefill 用高吞吐模式、decode 用低延迟模式)。另建议补 **DP attention**(DeepSeek 类 MLA 模型减少 KV 复制的关键,SGLang 首创)。
3. KV cache 一项建议明确「4 级层次」:HBM→DRAM→SSD→远端池,对应 KVBM 官方描述;「offload」只是手段,层次化+跨实例复用才是卖点。
4. 「MTP/DSpark」:DSpark 全称 *Confidence-Scheduled Speculative Decoding with Semi-Autoregressive Generation*(arXiv 2607.05147),是部署在 DeepSeek-V4 线上服务、对标 MTP-1 的下一代投机解码——deck 里写成「MTP → DSpark(演进)」而非并列。
5. DCP 是 vLLM 2026-08 发布的官方特性名「Decode Context Parallelism」,写法正确。
6. 建议补「agg vs disagg 可切换」标注:2025-2026 研究共识是 disagg 并非永远更优(小规模/短输入 agg 更好),Dynamo/SGLang 均支持两种模式,这是售前很好的「不过度承诺」话术。

---

## 3. 技术点收益表(进 notes)

| 技术点 | 典型收益 | 代价 | 适用 | 不适用 | 出处 |
|--------|---------|------|------|--------|------|
| Continuous batching | 最高 **23x** 吞吐 vs 静态批(OPT-13B, A100, vLLM);vs FasterTransformer 也有 4x | 几乎无;现代引擎默认开启 | 一切在线服务(基线能力) | —(已是行业默认,不宜当卖点,当「基础」讲) | Anyscale blog |
| Chunked prefill | 服务容量 **2.6x**(Mistral-7B)~**3.7x**(Yi-34B)vs vLLM 当时版本;PP 场景最高 5.6x | prefill 略变慢;chunk 大小需调优 | 聚合部署、长短请求混跑、要压 P99 TPOT | 已做 PD 分离的部署(冲突);极端 TTFT 敏感长输入 | Sarathi-Serve, OSDI'24 (arXiv 2403.02310) |
| PD 分离 | **7.4x** 请求量或 **12.6x** 更严 SLO(DistServe vs 当时 SOTA);SGLang 96×H100 实测 52.3k in / 22.3k out tok/s/node | 需 RDMA/NVLink 传 KV;运维复杂;P:D 配比要随流量调(Planner 的活) | 大规模、严 TTFT+TPOT 双 SLO、长输入 | 单机小规模、低流量(agg 更优);带宽不足的网络 | DistServe OSDI'24 (arXiv 2401.09670); LMSYS blog |
| FP8 量化 | **~2.3x** vs FP16(Llama-2-7B, H100, TRT-LLM) | 需精度校验;校准数据 | Hopper 及以后;吞吐/成本优先 | 未做精度评测的高敏场景 | TRT-LLM quantization blog |
| NVFP4 量化 | 生成吞吐 **2-3x**,精度近无损(DeepSeek-R1、Nemotron 等) | 仅 Blackwell 有 FP4 硬件;需 ModelOpt PTQ 流程 | B200/GB200 平台 | Hopper 及更早(退回 FP8) | NVIDIA PTQ blog |
| wide-EP + DeepEP | 输出吞吐最高 **5x** vs 同资源纯 TP;GB200 NVL72 达 26k in / 13k out tok/s/GPU(DeepSeek-R1) | 多节点互联依赖;专家负载均衡(EPLB);故障爆炸半径大 | 大 MoE(DeepSeek/Kimi 类)、大集群 | 稠密模型;小集群 | LMSYS large-scale EP blog; LMSYS×NVIDIA InferenceMAX blog |
| MTP / 投机解码 | DeepSeek-V3 MTP:第 2 token 接受率 85-90% → **1.8x** TPS;SGLang MTP 实现:输出吞吐 +60% | 草稿头额外算力;高并发/大 batch 下收益衰减 | 延迟敏感 decode、低中并发 | 吞吐饱和的大 batch(见 DSpark 针对性解法) | DeepSeek-V3 报告 (arXiv 2412.19437); LMSYS MTP blog |
| DSpark | 同吞吐水位下单用户生成速度 **+60-85%**(DeepSeek-V4 线上,对标 MTP-1);接受长度显著提升 | 置信度调度的验证开销;半自回归骨干需训练配合 | 高并发服务下仍要单流速度(Pareto 前沿右移) | 无 MTP 类骨干的存量模型 | arXiv 2607.05147 |
| DCP(decode context parallel) | **6,091** tok/s/GPU vs TP 基线 ~1,863(**≈3.3x**,Kimi K2.6, 8×B200, 并发 512,中位输入 67k) | dcp 增大 → attention 通信开销增 | 长上下文 agentic(长输入短输出)、KV 吃紧 | 短上下文(收益消失,纯付通信税) | vLLM DCP blog (2026-08) |
| KV offload / 多级缓存 | Mooncake Store+vLLM:吞吐 **3.8x**、P50 TTFT **46x** 降、命中率 1.7%→92.2%;HiCache:吞吐最高 6x、TTFT -80%;LMCache(MI300X agentic):TTFT avg -3x;LMCache MoE 新架构:TTFT -13x | DRAM/SSD/远端存储成本;传输带宽;缓存一致性运维 | 多轮对话、Agent 工作流、共享长前缀(RAG 系统提示) | 前缀不复用的一次性短请求(命中率低,白付分层开销) | vLLM×Mooncake blog; LMSYS HiCache blog; LMCache blogs |

注:收益均为特定模型/硬件/负载下的公开数字,deck 中建议标「up to」并脚注出处;PD 分离与 chunked prefill 二选一,MTP 与大 batch 吞吐目标存在张力——这两条「不适用」列是技术可信度的加分项。

【常见追问】为何不自研模型?——定位是 factory 不是 lab:开源旗舰每季度迭代,「T+7 快速切换」的工程能力比自研模型性价比高得多;post-train 服务是未来可选的增值层,已在服务形式中预留。

数据口径:模型参数来自各家官方发布/HF(2026-08~09);SLA 事实来自 Fireworks 文档与第三方监测。"""

### 1.2 Batch 折扣

- **Fireworks**:Batch inference 按 serverless 价的 **50%** 计费(输入、输出均适用)。原文:"Batch inference is billed at 50% of serverless pricing on both input and output."(docs.fireworks.ai/serverless/pricing)
- **Together**:pricing 页有 "Batch API price" 切换页签,但抓取到的 batch 表与 serverless 表数值相同(如 Kimi K3 $3.00/$15.00)。**折扣比例未核实,标 null**,财务模型勿假设 50%。
- **DeepInfra**:无 batch 档,但有 **Flex 档 = 0.8×**(GLM-5.3 页面实测)。

NOTES = """本页回答:整座工厂由哪些层组成、为什么这样分层。

【讲解主线】上三层是「流量面」——同一个请求经过三级粒度的调度:全球流量调度层选集群(就近/容灾/配额),API 网关与路由层选 worker(cache 亲和、负载),推理 Serving 层排 batch(continuous batching)。中间 Serving 层是「产能面」,是 token 真正被生产出来的地方(p4 展开)。下两层是「物理面」。资源层与基础设施层的分界 = K8s 能调度的 vs 不能调度的。

【每层要点】
- 应用层:客户的 Agent/行业应用通过 OpenAI 兼容 API 接入,不感知下层。
- 全球流量调度:cluster 粒度。GSLB/就近接入 + 多集群容灾 + 大客户配额与优先级;serverless 与专属 MaaS 在这一层开始分流。
- API 网关与路由:worker 粒度。认证计费限流之外,核心是两类调度——cache-aware(把同前缀请求路由到已有 KV 的 worker,提高 prefix cache 命中率、降 TTFT 与成本)与 load-aware(避免长请求堆积单 worker)。业界对应:NVIDIA Dynamo Smart Router、SGLang router、K8s Gateway API Inference Extension。
- 推理 Serving:model instance 粒度。SGLang/vLLM/TensorRT-LLM 作为 serving backend,Dynamo 提供 PD 分离、KV 块管理(KVBM)等编排能力;一个 model instance = 一组 prefill/decode worker + 并行化配置。
- 资源层:GPU(NVL72 域/HGX 节点)、三类存储、多张网络平面 —— 全部以 K8s 资源池形式暴露。
- 基础设施:电力/液冷/基建,GB300 级机架 142kW 必须直液冷,常是项目的真正长杠杆(p9)。

【纵向域为什么不放进层里】它们跨层生效:安全(租户隔离从网关到 GPU 分区)、可观测(每层都出指标,SLA 看板要能按层下钻定位)、性能仿真评估(上线前用 Simulator/benchmark 回答「这套配置能不能扛住这个 workload」——本方案配套的 AI Factory Simulator 就属于这个域)、高可用扩缩容(Planner 按 SLA 与流量画像动态调 worker 数量与 PD 配比,对应 Dynamo Planner 命名)、K8s 与软件平台(一切之上的编排与交付)。

【常见追问】为什么要两级路由而不是一个大网关?——粒度不同:全球层决策以秒/分钟计(集群健康、容量水位),网关层决策以毫秒计(KV 亲和、队列深度),合并会互相拖累。

口径说明:分层命名参照 NVIDIA Dynamo / 云厂商 MaaS 与 K8s 推理网关生态的通行叫法;细节对齐持续修订中(本页为 v1 框架稿)。"""

````md
# A1 — 2026 新发布开源模型架构参数与 KV cache 口径

调研日期:2026-09-03。来源优先级:HF 原始 config.json(逐字抓取)> HF transformers 官方文档 > 官方 model card > 二手报道。
所有 config.json 字段为一手来源;总/激活参数、日期、license 以 model card 与多源交叉为准。
KV 公式中 `B_kv` = KV cache 每元素字节数(见各表 kv_dtype 说明),`T` = context 长度(token)。

---

## 1. GLM-5.2(Z.ai / zai-org)

一手来源:`zai-org/GLM-5.2` config.json(2026-09-03 抓取)。架构 `GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM`(MLA + DeepSeek-式稀疏注意力 DSA + IndexShare)。

| 字段 | 值 | 来源/置信度 |
|---|---|---|
| 总参数 | 753B(HF safetensors 计数,含 1 层 MTP);~744B 不含 MTP | model card 753B;press 744B。高 |
| 激活参数 | ~40B(press 口径;由 config 推算 ≈41B) | **估计**,官方卡未标注 |
| 层数 | 78(+1 MTP 层,`num_nextn_predict_layers:1`) | config,高 |
| hidden_size | 6144;dense FFN 12288 | config,高 |
| MoE | 前 3 层 dense;75 层 MoE:256 routed / top-8 / 1 shared,expert 中间维 2048,sigmoid+noaux_tc 路由 | config,高 |
| 注意力 | MLA:64 heads,qk_nope 192 + qk_rope 64(qk_head_dim 256),v_head_dim 256,kv_lora_rank 512,q_lora_rank 2048 | config,高 |
| 稀疏注意力 | DSA:indexer 32 heads × dim 128,top-k **2048**;IndexShare:78 层中 21 层自带 indexer("full":层 0,1,2 及此后每 4 层 1 个),其余 57 层复用(`index_topk_freq:4`)。官方称 1M ctx 下 per-token FLOPs 降 2.9× | config + model card,高 |
| **KV 逐层口径** | **全部 78 层随 context 线性增长**。每层每 token 缓存 MLA 潜向量 = kv_lora_rank(512) + rope(64) = **576 元素**。DSA(top-2048)只降 attention 计算,不降 KV 存储。另有 indexer key cache:21 个自带 indexer 的层 × 128 元素/token(V3.2 惯例 FP8) | config 推导,高(缓存潜向量而非展开 K/V 由 kv_lora_rank 存在及 DSA 血统推定) |
| 每 token KV 合计 | 78×576 = 44,928 元素 ×B_kv;BF16 ≈ 87.8 KB/token,FP8 ≈ 43.9 KB/token;+ indexer 21×128×1B ≈ 2.6 KB | 推导 |
| 权重 dtype | **BF16 发布**(dtype:bfloat16,无 quantization_config)≈ 2 B/param,checkpoint ≈1.5 TB | config,高 |
| KV cache dtype | 官方未标注 → null;按 DSA 血统 FP8 潜向量可行,保守取 BF16 | 不确定 |
| context | 1,048,576(1M),rope_theta 8e6 | config,高 |
| license | MIT | model card,高 |
| 发布 | 2026-06 中旬(press 称 06-13 发布,model card 博客日期 06-17;精确日 null) | press,中 |

```python
GLM_5_2 = {
    "name": "GLM-5.2",
    "total_params_b": 753,          # HF safetensors 计数, 含 MTP; 不含 MTP ~744
    "active_params_b": 40,          # press 口径, config 推算 ~41; 官方未标注
    "num_layers": 78,               # 不含 1 层 MTP
    "hidden_size": 6144,
    "moe": {"n_routed_experts": 256, "top_k": 8, "n_shared_experts": 1,
            "moe_intermediate_size": 2048, "first_k_dense": 3, "moe_layers": 75},
    "attention": [
        {"kind": "MLA+DSA", "layers": 78,
         # 全部层 KV 随 context 增长; DSA top-2048 只省算力不省显存
         "kv_bytes_per_token_formula": "(kv_lora_rank(512) + qk_rope(64)) * B_kv",
         "kv_elems_per_token_per_layer": 576,
         "params": {"kv_lora_rank": 512, "qk_rope_head_dim": 64, "qk_nope_head_dim": 192,
                    "v_head_dim": 256, "num_heads": 64, "q_lora_rank": 2048,
                    "index_topk": 2048, "index_n_heads": 32, "index_head_dim": 128,
                    "indexer_owner_layers": 21, "index_topk_freq": 4}},
        {"kind": "dsa_indexer_cache", "layers": 21,
         "kv_bytes_per_token_formula": "index_head_dim(128) * 1  # indexer key, FP8 惯例",
         "params": {"index_head_dim": 128}},
    ],
    "kv_growth_elems_per_token": 78 * 576,     # 44928, 不含 indexer
    "weight_bytes_per_param": 2.0,             # BF16 发布
    "kv_dtype_bytes": 2,                       # 官方未标注; FP8(1) 可行, 保守 BF16
    "context_k": 1024,                         # 1,048,576 tokens
    "license": "MIT",
    "release_date": "2026-06",                 # 精确日不确定(06-13 或 06-17)
}
```

## 2. GLM-5.3(Z.ai / zai-org)

一手来源:`zai-org/GLM-5.3` config.json(2026-09-03 抓取)+ press。**与 GLM-5.2 同底座**:官方明确无新预训练、无架构改动,收益全部来自扩大后训练(environment scaling)。config 逐项与 5.2 一致(6144/78 层/256 专家 top-8/kv_lora 512/index_topk 2048/1M ctx/indexer_types 78 项)。

与 5.2 的唯一交付差异:**GLM-5.3 权重以 FP8(dynamic activation scheme)发布**,约 900 个模块排除在量化外(保持 BF16;具体排除集未逐项核对)→ checkpoint 约减半。

| 字段 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 发布 | 2026-08-14,开源权重在 HF,license 沿用 MIT(model card) |
| KV 口径 | 与 GLM-5.2 完全相同(同架构) |
| 权重 dtype | FP8 为主(≈1 B/param)+ 少量 BF16 排除模块;有效 ≈1.0–1.1 B/param(估计) |

GLM_5_3 = {
    **GLM_5_2,

    "weight_bytes_per_param": 1.05,   # FP8 发布 + ~900 个 BF16 排除模块, 估计值
    "release_date": "2026-08-14",
    "notes": "同 GLM-5.2 底座, 仅后训练升级; KV/架构参数全同",
}
```

## 3. Kimi-K3(Moonshot AI / moonshotai)

一手来源:`moonshotai/Kimi-K3` config.json 全文(2026-09-03 抓取)+ model card。架构 `KimiK3ForConditionalGeneration`(text_config: `kimi_linear`),KDA 线性注意力 + gated MLA 混合,Attention Residuals(`attn_res_block_size:12`),Stable LatentMoE。

| 字段 | 值 | 来源/置信度 |
|---|---|---|
| 总/激活参数 | **2.8T / 104B**(官方卡);checkpoint ~1.56 TB | model card + press,高 |
| 层数 | 93(config 列表 1-indexed:1..93);第 1 层 dense FFN(intermediate 33792),92 层 MoE;**无 MTP**(num_nextn_predict_layers:0) | config,高 |
| hidden_size | 7168,96 heads | config,高 |
| MoE(LatentMoE) | 896 routed / top-16 / 2 shared;routed expert 在潜空间:routed_expert_hidden_size **3584**,expert 中间维 3072(单 routed expert ≈33M;892×… 校验 2.72T ≈ 总量主体) | config,高 |
| 注意力混合 | **69 层 KDA + 24 层 gated MLA**,3:1 交错(full_attn_layers = 4,8,...,88,92,93 —— 注意末尾 92、93 连续两层 MLA) | config,高 |
| KDA(线性) | num_heads 96,head_dim 128,short_conv kernel 4,full-rank gate。**状态恒定不随 context 增长**:每层 ≈ heads×d_k×d_v = 96×128×128 = 1,572,864 元素;69 层 ≈ 1.085×10⁸ 元素/序列(BF16 ≈217 MB,FP32 ≈434 MB;另有少量 conv 状态) | config + 公式推导,状态 dtype 未公布 |
| MLA | kv_lora_rank 512,**mla_use_nope: true(NoPE,不缓存 rope key)**,mla_use_output_gate: true(gated),qk_nope 128,v_head 128,q_lora 1536。每层每 token 缓存 **512 元素**(若实现仍缓存 rope 64 则 576,上界) | config,高(NoPE 由 config 字段明示) |
| 每 token KV 合计 | 仅 24 层 MLA 增长:24×512 = 12,288 元素 ×B_kv;BF16 ≈ 24 KB/token + KDA 恒定 ~217 MB/序列(BF16 计) | 推导 |
| 权重 dtype | **MXFP4**(group 32,uint8 scale ⇒ ≈4.25 bit ≈0.53 B/param)**仅作用于 routed experts**;self_attn、shared_experts、dense MLP、lm_head、vision 全部 BF16(quantization ignore 列表)。激活 MXFP8(QAT)。整体有效 ≈ 1.56TB/2.8T ≈ **0.557 B/param** | config + model card,高 |
| KV cache dtype | config `kv_cache_scheme: null` → 未量化,默认 BF16 | config,中 |
| 视觉 | MoonViT-V2 401M(27 层,vt_hidden 1024,patch 14) | config + card,高 |
| context | 1,048,576(1M) | config,高 |
| license | **Kimi K3 License**(自定义;类 MIT 但含营收触发条款:MaaS 业务 12 个月营收超 $20M 须与 Moonshot 另签协议;不符合 OSI 开源定义。条款细节以 LICENSE 原文为准) | 多个二手源,中 |
| 发布 | 2026-07-16(App/API),**2026-07-27 开源权重上 HF** | press 多源,高 |

## 4. DeepSeek-V4-Flash 与 DeepSeek-V4-Pro(deepseek-ai)

一手来源:两仓库 config.json + **HF transformers 官方文档 model_doc/deepseek_v4**(注意力机制最权威描述,2026-09-03 抓取)。架构 `DeepseekV4ForCausalLM`:放弃 MLA,改为 **Shared K=V MQA + 混合压缩注意力(CSA/HCA)+ mHC 超连接 + Hash-MoE 启动层**。

注意力机制要点(HF transformers 文档,逐句核实):
- **Shared K=V MQA**:`num_key_value_heads=1`,head_dim **512**,kv_proj 产出单个 512 维向量,**同一张量同时作 K 和 V** → 每个被缓存位置只存 512 元素(不是 1024)。Partial RoPE 只旋转其中尾部 64 维,不增加缓存。
- 三种层型(config `compress_ratios` 逐层,0/4/128;数组末尾多 1 项对应 MTP 层):
  - `0` = **sliding-window-only**:仅本地窗 128,**KV 恒定**(128×512 元素/层);
  - `4` = **CSA**:序列 4× 压缩池(重叠窗)+ Lightning Indexer(64 heads × dim 128)对压缩条目打分取 top-k(Flash 512 / Pro 1024)→ 摊销每 token 存 512/4=128 元素 + indexer key 128/4=32 元素;
  - `128` = **HCA**:128× 压缩池(非重叠窗,无 indexer)→ 摊销每 token 存 512/128=4 元素。
- 每层都另有恒定的 sliding-window(128)K=V 分支与 per-head attention sink。
- MoE 前 3 层为 hash_moe(冻结 token-id→expert-id 哈希路由,专家权重照常存在)。

| 字段 | V4-Flash | V4-Pro | 来源/置信度 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 总/激活参数 | **284B / 13B** | **1.6T / 49B** | 官方 model card,高 |
| 层数 | 43(+1 MTP) | 61(+1 MTP) | config,高 |
| hidden_size / heads | 4096 / 64 | 7168 / 128 | config,高 |
| MoE | 256 routed / top-6 / 1 shared,inter 2048,hash 层 3 | 384 routed / top-6 / 1 shared,inter 3072,hash 层 3 | config,高 |
| 层型分布(由 compress_ratios 数组统计) | 2 sliding-only(层0-1)+ **21 CSA + 20 HCA** | **30 CSA + 31 HCA**(层0-1 为 HCA 启动)| config 数组逐项计数,中-高(±1 层可能,见不确定项) |
| index_topk / indexer | 512;64 heads × 128 dim | 1024;64 heads × 128 dim | config,高 |
| **每 token KV 增长(摊销)** | 21×(128+32) + 20×4 = **3,440 元素** | 30×(128+32) + 31×4 = **4,924 元素** | 推导(公式高置信,层计数中) |
| 每 token KV 字节 | BF16 ≈6.9 KB,FP8 ≈3.4 KB | BF16 ≈9.8 KB,FP8 ≈4.9 KB | 推导 |
| 恒定开销/序列 | ≈43×128×512 元素(BF16 ≈5.6 MB) | ≈61×128×512(BF16 ≈8 MB) | 推导 |
| 官方压缩口径 | (同 Pro 表述) | 1M ctx 下 vs V3.2:**KV cache 仅 10%,单 token FLOPs 27%**(本表公式推得 ~11-14%,与官方口径同量级) | model card,高 |
| 权重 dtype | 主体 **FP8 e4m3**(block 128×128,ue8m0 scale);**MoE routed experts FP4**(expert_dtype: fp4)。官方:「MoE expert parameters use FP4 precision; most other parameters use FP8」 | 同左 | config + card,高 |
| 有效 B/param | ≈0.52(专家占绝对主体) | ≈0.51 | 推导 |
| KV cache dtype | 官方未标注 → null(FP8 池化条目可行;二手源称 indexer 以 FP4 运行,未证实) | 同左 | 不确定 |
| context | 1,048,576(YaRN ×16,原生 65,536) | 同左 | config,高 |
| license | MIT | MIT | model card,高 |
| 发布/GA | **2026-07-31**(V4-Flash-0731,开源权重+API) | **2026-08-13 GA**(V4-Pro-0813;OpenRouter 08-12 上架);V4 预览版约 2026-04-24 | press 多源 + API changelog,高 |

```python
DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH = {
    "name": "DeepSeek-V4-Flash",
    "total_params_b": 284,
    "active_params_b": 13,

    "hidden_size": 4096,
    "moe": {"n_routed_experts": 256, "top_k": 6, "n_shared_experts": 1,
            "moe_intermediate_size": 2048, "hash_moe_layers": 3, "moe_layers": 43},
    "attention": [
        # Shared K=V MQA: 1 个 KV 头 512 维, K/V 同一张量 → 每缓存位置 512 元素
        {"kind": "sliding_only", "layers": 2,
         "kv_bytes_per_token_formula": "0  # 恒定: 窗口 128*512 元素/层",
         "params": {"window": 128, "head_dim": 512}},
        {"kind": "CSA", "layers": 21,
         "kv_bytes_per_token_formula": "(512/4 + 128/4) * B_kv  # KV 池 4x + indexer key 4x",

         "params": {"head_dim": 512, "compress_ratio": 4, "index_topk": 512,
                    "index_n_heads": 64, "index_head_dim": 128, "window": 128}},
        {"kind": "HCA", "layers": 20,

         "kv_elems_per_token_per_layer": 4,
         "params": {"head_dim": 512, "compress_ratio": 128, "window": 128}},
    ],
    "kv_growth_elems_per_token": 3440,
    "weight_bytes_per_param": 0.52,   # 有效: experts FP4(~0.5) + 其余 FP8(1.0)
    "kv_dtype_bytes": None,           # 官方未标注; BF16=2 保守 / FP8=1 可能
    "context_k": 1024,

}

## 5. MiniMax-H3(MiniMaxAI)——仅基本事实

- 模态:**omni-modal 音视频生成系统**(理解文本/图像/视频/音频上下文,生成视频 + 原生 32kHz 立体声),非 LLM,不适用 KV cache 口径。
- 参数:H3-Omni-Transformer **33B**(其中 ~13B 为 AdaLN 相关分支);组件:H3-Context-IR(未开源,仅 API)、H3-Base(开源,768p 输出)、H3-Regenerate-2K(未开源)。
- 规格:4–15 秒 @24FPS,2K 需 Regenerate-2K;权重 BF16。
- license:**MiniMax H3 Community License Agreement**——美/欧盟/英/韩使用开源权重须向 MiniMax 申请授权,不属常规开源许可。
- 日期:2026-07-31 发布,2026-08-03 开源权重上 HF。

## 不确定项(null 纪律)

1. **KV cache dtype(全部四个 LLM)**:任何官方卡/config 均未声明推理 KV 精度。Kimi-K3 config `kv_cache_scheme: null` → 默认 BF16(2B);GLM 与 DeepSeek 的 DSA/V3.2 血统使 FP8(1B)潜向量/池条目可行但未证实。DeepSeek dict 中标 `None`,GLM/Kimi 取保守 BF16。容量规划建议按 BF16 上界 + FP8 下界双口径。
2. **GLM-5.2 激活参数**:官方 model card 未标注;40B 为 press 口径,由 config 推算 ≈41B(8 专家+1 shared+attention+embedding)。视作估计值 ±5%。
3. **GLM-5.2 总参数口径**:753B(HF 权重计数,含 MTP 层)vs 744B(press,推定不含 MTP);二者均有依据,dict 取 753。
4. **GLM-5.2 精确发布日**:press 06-13 vs model card 博客日期 06-17,取 2026-06,精确日 null。
5. **Kimi-K3 MLA 是否缓存 rope 维**:config `mla_use_nope: true` 明示 NoPE → 512 元素/层/token;若某实现仍缓存 64 维 rope 则 576(上界 +12.5%)。
6. **KDA 状态精确大小与 dtype**:heads×dk×dv 公式为标准 delta-rule 口径(96×128×128/层);short-conv 与 output-gate 附加状态少量未计;计算期常用 FP32,存储 dtype 官方未公布 → 规划时可按 BF16 217MB/序列 ~ FP32 434MB/序列 区间。
7. **DeepSeek V4 层型计数**:由 config `compress_ratios` 数组逐项统计(经小模型转写,±1 层误差可能):Flash 2/21/20,Pro 0/30/31(sliding/CSA/HCA)。聚合校验:Pro 公式值 ≈ V3.2 KV 的 11–14%,官方称 10%,同量级一致;差值可能来自 V3.2 基线是否含 indexer cache。
8. **DeepSeek indexer 运行精度 FP4**:仅二手源(morphllm)提及,官方未证实 → null。
9. **CSA「重叠窗」对池条目数的影响**:按 stride=4 摊销 1 条/4 token 计;若重叠导致条目更密,KV 增长上浮(官方聚合口径 10% 已隐含实际值,偏差有限)。
10. **Kimi K3 License 定性**:二手源分歧(「bespoke license」vs「modified-MIT-like」);$20M MaaS 营收触发条款为多源一致,精确条款以仓库 LICENSE 原文为准。
11. **GLM-5.3 FP8 排除模块集**:config 显示约 900 个模块不量化(保持 BF16),具体清单未逐项核对;`weight_bytes_per_param: 1.05` 为估计。
12. **MiniMax-H3 内部架构**:按任务要求仅核实基本事实,未深入。

## 5. Deck 快速结论(选型页可直接引用)

- **RTX PRO Server**:唯一"现货 + 风冷机房即插"的 Blackwell 企业推理平台;8 卡 768GB/30 PFLOPS FP4;单卡 70B@FP4;整机估 $180-250k(推算);短板是无 NVLink,大规模多卡紧耦合让位 NVL 平台。
- **HGX B300**:$430-690k/台,8-20+ 周交付,2026 已放量;11× Hopper 推理口径。
- **GB300 NVL72**:$3.5-6.5M/rack,6-12 个月,50× Hopper AI 工厂产出口径;液冷必须。
- **Vera Rubin NVL144**:2026-Q3 首发/Q4 放量,$5-8.8M 各口径不一,3.3× GB300;2026 内属"占位期货",2027 才是主力。

25	| KV cache dtype | 官方未标注 → null;按 DSA 血统 FP8 潜向量可行,保守取 BF16 | 不确定 |
26	| context | 1,048,576(1M),rope_theta 8e6 | config,高 |
27	| license | MIT | model card,高 |
28	| 发布 | 2026-06 中旬(press 称 06-13 发布,model card 博客日期 06-17;精确日 null) | press,中 |

136	## 4. DeepSeek-V4-Flash 与 DeepSeek-V4-Pro(deepseek-ai)
137	
138	一手来源:两仓库 config.json + **HF transformers 官方文档 model_doc/deepseek_v4**(注意力机制最权威描述,2026-09-03 抓取)。架构 `DeepseekV4ForCausalLM`:放弃 MLA,改为 **Shared K=V MQA + 混合压缩注意力(CSA/HCA)+ mHC 超连接 + Hash-MoE 启动层**。
139	
140	注意力机制要点(HF transformers 文档,逐句核实):
141	- **Shared K=V MQA**:`num_key_value_heads=1`,head_dim **512**,kv_proj 产出单个 512 维向量,**同一张量同时作 K 和 V** → 每个被缓存位置只存 512 元素(不是 1024)。Partial RoPE 只旋转其中尾部 64 维,不增加缓存。
142	- 三种层型(config `compress_ratios` 逐层,0/4/128;数组末尾多 1 项对应 MTP 层):
143	  - `0` = **sliding-window-only**:仅本地窗 128,**KV 恒定**(128×512 元素/层);
144	  - `4` = **CSA**:序列 4× 压缩池(重叠窗)+ Lightning Indexer(64 heads × dim 128)对压缩条目打分取 top-k(Flash 512 / Pro 1024)→ 摊销每 token 存 512/4=128 元素 + indexer key 128/4=32 元素;
145	  - `128` = **HCA**:128× 压缩池(非重叠窗,无 indexer)→ 摊销每 token 存 512/128=4 元素。
146	- 每层都另有恒定的 sliding-window(128)K=V 分支与 per-head attention sink。
147	- MoE 前 3 层为 hash_moe(冻结 token-id→expert-id 哈希路由,专家权重照常存在)。
148	
149	| 字段 | V4-Flash | V4-Pro | 来源/置信度 |
150	|---|---|---|---|
151	| 总/激活参数 | **284B / 13B** | **1.6T / 49B** | 官方 model card,高 |
152	| 层数 | 43(+1 MTP) | 61(+1 MTP) | config,高 |
153	| hidden_size / heads | 4096 / 64 | 7168 / 128 | config,高 |
154	| MoE | 256 routed / top-6 / 1 shared,inter 2048,hash 层 3 | 384 routed / top-6 / 1 shared,inter 3072,hash 层 3 | config,高 |
155	| 层型分布(由 compress_ratios 数组统计) | 2 sliding-only(层0-1)+ **21 CSA + 20 HCA** | **30 CSA + 31 HCA**(层0-1 为 HCA 启动)| config 数组逐项计数,中-高(±1 层可能,见不确定项) |
156	| index_topk / indexer | 512;64 heads × 128 dim | 1024;64 heads × 128 dim | config,高 |
157	| **每 token KV 增长(摊销)** | 21×(128+32) + 20×4 = **3,440 元素** | 30×(128+32) + 31×4 = **4,924 元素** | 推导(公式高置信,层计数中) |
158	| 每 token KV 字节 | BF16 ≈6.9 KB,FP8 ≈3.4 KB | BF16 ≈9.8 KB,FP8 ≈4.9 KB | 推导 |
159	| 恒定开销/序列 | ≈43×128×512 元素(BF16 ≈5.6 MB) | ≈61×128×512(BF16 ≈8 MB) | 推导 |
160	| 官方压缩口径 | (同 Pro 表述) | 1M ctx 下 vs V3.2:**KV cache 仅 10%,单 token FLOPs 27%**(本表公式推得 ~11-14%,与官方口径同量级) | model card,高 |
161	| 权重 dtype | 主体 **FP8 e4m3**(block 128×128,ue8m0 scale);**MoE routed experts FP4**(expert_dtype: fp4)。官方:「MoE expert parameters use FP4 precision; most other parameters use FP8」 | 同左 | config + card,高 |
162	| 有效 B/param | ≈0.52(专家占绝对主体) | ≈0.51 | 推导 |
163	| KV cache dtype | 官方未标注 → null(FP8 池化条目可行;二手源称 indexer 以 FP4 运行,未证实) | 同左 | 不确定 |
164	| context | 1,048,576(YaRN ×16,原生 65,536) | 同左 | config,高 |
165	| license | MIT | MIT | model card,高 |
166	| 发布/GA | **2026-07-31**(V4-Flash-0731,开源权重+API) | **2026-08-13 GA**(V4-Pro-0813;OpenRouter 08-12 上架);V4 预览版约 2026-04-24 | press 多源 + API changelog,高 |

228	## 5. MiniMax-H3(MiniMaxAI)——仅基本事实
229	
230	- 模态:**omni-modal 音视频生成系统**(理解文本/图像/视频/音频上下文,生成视频 + 原生 32kHz 立体声),非 LLM,不适用 KV cache 口径。
231	- 参数:H3-Omni-Transformer **33B**(其中 ~13B 为 AdaLN 相关分支);组件:H3-Context-IR(未开源,仅 API)、H3-Base(开源,768p 输出)、H3-Regenerate-2K(未开源)。
232	- 规格:4–15 秒 @24FPS,2K 需 Regenerate-2K;权重 BF16。
233	- license:**MiniMax H3 Community License Agreement**——美/欧盟/英/韩使用开源权重须向 MiniMax 申请授权,不属常规开源许可。
234	- 日期:2026-07-31 发布,2026-08-03 开源权重上 HF。

243	---
244	
245	## 不确定项(null 纪律)
246	
247	1. **KV cache dtype(全部四个 LLM)**:任何官方卡/config 均未声明推理 KV 精度。Kimi-K3 config `kv_cache_scheme: null` → 默认 BF16(2B);GLM 与 DeepSeek 的 DSA/V3.2 血统使 FP8(1B)潜向量/池条目可行但未证实。DeepSeek dict 中标 `None`,GLM/Kimi 取保守 BF16。容量规划建议按 BF16 上界 + FP8 下界双口径。
248	2. **GLM-5.2 激活参数**:官方 model card 未标注;40B 为 press 口径,由 config 推算 ≈41B(8 专家+1 shared+attention+embedding)。视作估计值 ±5%。
249	3. **GLM-5.2 总参数口径**:753B(HF 权重计数,含 MTP 层)vs 744B(press,推定不含 MTP);二者均有依据,dict 取 753。
250	4. **GLM-5.2 精确发布日**:press 06-13 vs model card 博客日期 06-17,取 2026-06,精确日 null。
251	5. **Kimi-K3 MLA 是否缓存 rope 维**:config `mla_use_nope: true` 明示 NoPE → 512 元素/层/token;若某实现仍缓存 64 维 rope 则 576(上界 +12.5%)。
252	6. **KDA 状态精确大小与 dtype**:heads×dk×dv 公式为标准 delta-rule 口径(96×128×128/层);short-conv 与 output-gate 附加状态少量未计;计算期常用 FP32,存储 dtype 官方未公布 → 规划时可按 BF16 217MB/序列 ~ FP32 434MB/序列 区间。
253	7. **DeepSeek V4 层型计数**:由 config `compress_ratios` 数组逐项统计(经小模型转写,±1 层误差可能):Flash 2/21/20,Pro 0/30/31(sliding/CSA/HCA)。聚合校验:Pro 公式值 ≈ V3.2 KV 的 11–14%,官方称 10%,同量级一致;差值可能来自 V3.2 基线是否含 indexer cache。
254	8. **DeepSeek indexer 运行精度 FP4**:仅二手源(morphllm)提及,官方未证实 → null。

188	## 6. 可引用的行业案例(售前 slide 用,p5-1/2/3 与 PoC 页)
189	
190	1. **软件栈复利(PoC 页核心论据)**:同一套 GB300 NVL72 硬件上,DeepSeek-V4-Pro 1.6T 的推理吞吐 43 天内从 ~2,200 提升到 **~11,200 tok/s/GPU**(50 tok/s/user,Dynamo+SGLang PD 分离 + MTP),纯软件优化 ~5×,输出成本降至 $0.156/M token。—— SemiAnalysis InferenceX (https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/blog/deepseekv4-16t-day-0-to-day-43-performance)
191	2. **wide-EP 是 NVL72 的核心杠杆(p5 架构页)**:GB300 288GB HBM 让 decode EP 从 8 拓宽到 16,同等交互性下对 GB200 NVL72 达 **2.83× tok/s/GPU、2.31× 每 token 成本优势**(V4-Pro FP4,Dynamo+vLLM,PD 分离)。—— SemiAnalysis (https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/blog/gb300-nvl72-vs-gb200-nvl72-dsv4-pro-vllm-fp4)
192	3. **万亿级 MoE 的代际经济性(TCO 页)**:NVIDIA 官方口径,GB300 NVL72 对 H200 NVL8 在 DeepSeek V4-Pro 上 **15× throughput/MW、10× 更低 $/M token**;在 Kimi K3 2.8T 上达 **80× throughput/MW**(110–160 tok/s/user 档)。—— NVIDIA 技术博客 (https://developer.nvidia.com/blog/nvidia-vera-rubin-and-blackwell-set-a-new-standard-for-agentic-ai-performance-per-watt/)
193	4. **2.8T 模型单机架落地(p5-2 案例)**:Kimi-K3 凭 MXFP4 QAT 在 8×B300 单节点即可服务(~196GB/GPU,527K 有效上下文,30 并发下 TTFT 中位 746ms);vLLM 官方在 GB300 上 DSpark 投机解码把单流解码从 118 提至 **370 tok/s/user(3.14×)**。—— Fixstars (https://blog.us.fixstars.com/deploying-kimi-k3-on-day-0-can-a-2-8t-model-run-on-a-single-node-of-nvidia-b300-x8/)、vLLM (https://vllm.ai/blog/2026-07-27-k3)
194	5. **中档 MoE 的低门槛(p5-3 案例)**:GLM-5.2 753B 用 NVFP4 在 **4×B200 聚合部署**即达 176.4 tok/s/GPU 系统吞吐、TTFT P50 355ms(64 并发,Dynamo+SGLang,MTP 接受长度 2.69);GLM-5.3 在 GB300 单流 556 tok/s、bs=256 节点 7,501 tok/s。—— NVIDIA Dynamo (https://docs.nvidia.com/dynamo/v1.4.0/recipes/glm-5-2)、SGLang (https://docs.sglang.io/cookbook/autoregressive/GLM/GLM-5.3)
195	6. **托管商差距即优化空间(商务页)**:同为 DeepSeek-V4-Pro,Fireworks 167 tok/s vs 其余 provider 33–41 tok/s(AA 口径,10K 输入);GLM-5.2 上 Fireworks 314.9 tok/s vs 一方 API 115.2 tok/s——说明推理工程能力本身就是 3–5× 的差异化。—— DeepInfra 博客转述 AA 数据 (https://deepinfra.com/blog/deepseek-v4-pro-max-api-benchmarks-latency-throughput-cost 、https://deepinfra.com/blog/best-glm-5-2-max-api-providers)

4	 * ⚠️ 本文件产出的所有性能数字都是 roofline 示意估算，仅供教学与量级感知，
5	 *    既非实测 benchmark，也不能作为可承诺产能对外报出：
6	 *    - prefill 视为**算力瓶颈**：FLOPs ≈ 2 × 激活参数 × prompt tokens，除以 (算力 × MFU)
